preprocessing: Equal atlas cells; trim transparent margins with 4px edge allowance; proportional fit in a 216px square plus 20px transparent padding; no drawn or edited paths.

properties.selectedRationale: Crisp unambiguous property glyphs; first transparent sheet rejected for visible noise.
properties.preprocessing: Extract exact atlas cells; remove white background by luminance coverage, dropping coverage <=16; retain ink edges; trim with 4px allowance; contain-fit at the declared prepared resolution with transparent margins. No paths redrawn.
